## Session Overview

As we conclude our work in UP 591 for the fall semester, we'll run a studio-style peer review of near-final portfolios and launch the first structured feedback exchange with your mentors.

### When we Meet

Studio-style peer review of near-final portfolios.

### Reflect

Launch of the December structured feedback exchange: your mentor provides preliminary developmental feedback (strengths, one growth area, one concrete step), and you complete a confidential evaluation of the match.

## Before we Meet

Watch our (short) **December pre-session video**.

Bring a near-final portfolio draft — the strongest version you have, with constituent pieces and statements organized in a logical fashion.

Submit your [Draft Portfolio](../milestones/04_portfolio.qmd).

## After we Meet

- Complete the December feedback exchange with your mentor (they provide preliminary developmental feedback; you complete the confidential mentor evaluation).

- Think critically about how you will complete your workshop, project, or thesis deliverables next semester. If something you originally proposed is now no longer feasible, now is an important time to communicate this to your instructor, client, or advisor.

- For those of you pursuing the project or thesis options, please share a substantive capstone update with your project / thesis adviser before the end of the semester.

**Course milestone:** Draft Portfolio (Dec).

**Mentoring milestone:** December structured feedback exchange + mentee evaluation.
